name: Claude Code Lean Engineering Stack
principles: Use the smallest useful workflow for the task.
Prefer targeted context over repository-wide loading.
Verify graph conclusions against source files.
Do not invoke skills or subagents merely because they are available.
Use fresh independent review only when risk justifies it.

components.name: Claude Code
whenToUse: All normal coding and repository work.

components.name: Global CLAUDE.md
components.role: Global orchestration rules for the engineering stack.
whenToUse: Loaded automatically in Claude Code sessions.
whenNotToUse: Do not put project-specific volatile details here.

components.name: Codebase Memory
components.role: Structural code intelligence: architecture, dependencies, call paths and blast radius.
whenNotToUse: Trivial edits or obvious single-file changes.
notes: Verify important graph conclusions against source files.

components.name: Agent Reach
components.role: External/current research across supported web and developer sources.
whenToUse: Official docs, current GitHub/release research, community evidence when useful.
whenNotToUse: When the repository already contains enough evidence.

components.name: frontend-design
components.role: Specialized workflow for substantial frontend and UI design/implementation.
whenToUse: Substantial frontend/UI work where design quality matters.

components.name: skill-creator
components.role: Workflow for creating or improving Claude skills.
whenNotToUse: One-off instructions that do not deserve a skill.

components.name: tdd-adaptive
components.role: Selective test-first workflow for risky behavior changes.
whenNotToUse: Trivial CSS/copy/config edits where meaningful tests add little value.

components.name: verification-loop
components.role: Final engineering quality gate: build, types, lint, tests, runtime when useful, final diff.
whenToUse: Before claiming significant engineering work is complete.

components.name: fresh-code-reviewer
components.role: Independent fresh-context review of significant completed changes.

components.name: SkillSpector
components.role: Supply-chain security gate before installing third-party agent infrastructure.
whenToUse: Before installing third-party skills, MCPs, plugins, agents, hooks or agent frameworks.

components.name: Headroom
components.role: Transparent local context/proxy optimization beneath normal Claude Code CLI sessions.
whenNotToUse: Do not ask Claude to invoke it as a reasoning tool.
notes: No Headroom MCP in the lean architecture.

components.name: Graphify
whenToUse: A visual, exportable or multimodal graph is explicitly useful.
whenNotToUse: Routine source architecture, call-path or blast-radius analysis.
notes: Codebase Memory is the default day-to-day graph system.

stackFooter.format: [STACK] CBM: yes|no | Reach: yes|no | Skills: <names|none> | Agents: <names/count|none> | SkillSpector: yes|no | Headroom: routed
